title: Choosing a Room in a Shared House · 独立口语迁移
instructions: 先完成示范段的跟读诊断，再用不同人物、信息或立场录制自己的完整回答。示范与自由回答分别取证，服务未提供完整听音评阅时保持待评。
reference: A) My name is Anna. I am a student. I live in a small city. I want a new room. I look at a shared house near my school. The house is big. There are three bedrooms. There is one kitchen. There is one bathroom. The living room is small. There are some chairs and a table. There is no TV. B) I meet the house manager. His name is Tom. He shows me two rooms. Room 1 is upstairs. It is small. There is a bed and a desk. There is no window. Room 2 is downstairs. It is big. There is a bed, a desk, and a window. The window is near the garden. There are some flowers in the garden. I like Room 2. But the rent is high. Room 1 is cheap. There is a problem: Room 1 has no window. I need a window for my plants.
prompt:
Part 1
Do you live in a house or an apartment?
What is your favorite room?
Is there a park near your home?
Do you like your room? Why?

Part 2
Describe a room you like. You should say: where it is, what is in it, why you like it, and how you feel in it.

Part 3
What makes a room good for studying?
Do you prefer a big room or a small room?
Is it important to have a window in a room?
How can people make a small room look nice?
